cohort: The cohort included 95,149 ART birth records from California (2000-2016) successfully linked to the National ART Surveillance System, which were then matched 1:1 using propensity scores to non-ART births.
finding: The hazard risk ratio for autism diagnosis following ART compared with non-ART conception is 1.26 (95% CI, 1.17-1.35).
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery, along with multiple birth and preterm birth, jointly mediate 77.9% of the relationship between ART conception and autism diagnosis.
